changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Execution') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[Execution]( Id int identity not null, [ExecutionID] uniqueidentifier not null, [ResourceID] int not null, [Total] int not null, [Processed] int not null, [Error] int not null, [StartedOn] datetime not null, [ProcessingStartedOn] datetime null, [CompletedOn] datetime null, [Fields] nvarchar(2500) null, [RetryCount] int null, [ErrorMessage] nvarchar(2500) null, [Action] int null, [Method] varchar(7) null, [Route] varchar(250) null, [State] int CONSTRAINT [DF_Execution_State] DEFAULT (1) not null, ApplicationID nvarchar(200) null, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecution] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC ) ) END
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'MarkedForProcessing') BEGIN alter table api.Execution drop constraint [DF_Execution_MarkedForProcessing] alter table api.Execution drop column [MarkedForProcessing] END
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'Id') BEGIN alter table api.Execution add Id int identity not null END
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'RetryCount') BEGIN alter table api.Execution add [RetryCount] int null END
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[Execution]') AND name = 'Action') BEGIN alter table api.Execution add [Action] int null; END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Api_Execution_CompletedOn_StartedOn') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_Api_Execution_CompletedOn_StartedOn ON api.Execution (CompletedOn, StartedOn) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Api_Execution_Route_Include') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_Api_Execution_Route_Include ON api.Execution ([Route]) INCLUDE (CompletedOn, ExecutionID) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Api_Execution_ResourceID') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_Api_Execution_ResourceID ON api.Execution ( ResourceID ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_ApiExecution') BEGIN create clustered index CIX_ApiExecution ON api.Execution ( Id asc ) END
